title: LabelResult
description: Response body of POST /label/read. Values the model couldn't read are null and listed in flagged, so the app can ask the user to fill them in.

flagged.description: Dotted names of fields that were unreadable or failed a check (kcal ≈ 4·protein + 4·carbs + 9·fat; per_serving ≈ per_100g × serving_grams / 100), e.g. "per_100g.fat". Empty when everything checks out.
